name: Soraka
notes: Soraka opens by casting Equinox (E) as soon as it is off cooldown: the cast lands its on-cast magic damage immediately, then keeps her busy for E's 0.25 s cast time before anything else can start; the zone erupts for the same damage again 1.5 s later (a scheduled event, not a further cast); E is recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight.

Starcall (Q) is cast on cooldown throughout the fight, one cast at a time with every other cast: the cast itself costs its 0.25 s cast time, and its damage lands separately, 1.0 s after the cast, assuming Soraka casts it at maximum range (800), the safest range a support would use in practice, matching the wiki's stated delay of 0.25 s at 50 range up to 1 s at 800 range.

Between Q and E casts Soraka basic-attacks the target; her kit adds no on-hit damage or attack-speed steroid, so attacks are a minor, standard contributor and are otherwise handled by the engine's default attack loop.
Astral Infusion (W) and Wish (R) only heal (and cost Soraka mana/health); they deal no damage and are never cast in this damage-only fight, so their 0.25 s cast times are recorded but unused.
Mana is not modeled: Soraka's level-16 base mana pool comfortably covers Q and E casts for the fight lengths simulated here.

Equinox's on-cast and eruption hits are each the same base damage and AP ratio (matching the wiki's explicit doubled total); only the on-cast instance triggers once-per-cast item procs (Muramana, Eclipse, etc.), since both hits come from a single cast.

assumed.why: Starcall's travel delay scales linearly with cast distance from 0.25s at 50 range to 1s at 800 range; assumed a max-range (800) cast, the safest range a support would use, giving the full 1.0s delay.

unused.W: Astral Infusion only heals an allied champion at the cost of Soraka's own health/mana; it deals no damage, so it is never cast in this damage-only dummy fight.
unused.R: Wish only heals Soraka and allies; it deals no damage, so it is never cast in this damage-only dummy fight.
